recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes FHIR-37814 on the current build surfaces without changing the already-correct element deletion, search parameter deletion, or general-contact code; any broader unrelated ResearchStudy ModelInfo drift should be handled separately.
issue_request: FHIR-37814 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by BRR. It requested deleting ResearchStudy.sponsor, ResearchStudy.principalInvestigator, and ResearchStudy.contact; representing sponsor and principal investigator through ResearchStudy.associatedParty.role; representing study contact details through Organization.contact or PractitionerRole.contact; and adding general-contact to the ResearchStudyPartyRole value set.
initial_application: Historical commit 7ccd9aba95d8fb0cddec9a53753d4493c502eddf removed the three ResearchStudy elements and added general-contact to the party role code system. Commit 00fcfcd63b removed the sponsor and principalinvestigator search parameters, and later ResearchStudy terminology commits preserved the general-contact role. Current authoritative ResearchStudy source already lacked the deleted elements and included general-contact.
additional_context: BRR minutes from 2022-07-26 record the same proposal and an 11-0-0 motion, and 2022-08-23 minutes list FHIR-37814 as applied. ResearchStudy and Library are active build resources; publish.ini copies the FHIR ModelInfo content, and the Library examples list includes Library/library-fhir-model-definition. The remaining issue-specific gaps were stale associatedParty guidance, r4-r6 change annotations using a non-existent associatedPart path, and FHIR ModelInfo metadata exposing the deleted fields instead of associatedParty.
reconciliation: Published commit fcaa007a8c62598d120607d0e42441d84e77f0bb updates ResearchStudy.associatedParty guidance, corrects fhir.ini migration annotations, and updates both FHIR ModelInfo content and embedded Library.data so ResearchStudy omits contact/sponsor/principalInvestigator and includes associatedParty with name, role, period, classifier, and party.
